==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is an old woman that I feel like I've seen in my dreams before. She is a teacher at a school. She has a very eccentric personality.

She claims to possess evidence of paranormal phenomenon. She likes to tell stories about the phenomenon she's witnessed during her lectures. All of the phenomenon she's witnessed is connected to the school itself.

She's seen a student with long hair and braces shrink to the size of a toy, turn green, and escape through a mouse hole. She has a book of monsters that she uses to reference her many paranormal sightings. Despite how wild her claims are, everyone seems to believe her.
